name: Daily range
summary: This EA trades based on daily range breakouts, identifying the high and low of a defined daily period and placing pending orders at those levels. When price breaks above the daily high or below the daily low, the EA enters a trade in the direction of the breakout, targeting range extension moves.
summary_zh: 该EA基于日线范围突破交易，识别特定日线周期内的最高价和最低价，并在这些水平上放置挂单。当价格突破日线高点或低点时，EA沿突破方向入场交易，目标捕捉区间延伸走势。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于日线价格区间的突破交易，认为当价格突破前一日的最高价或最低价时，趋势可能延续。入场条件为价格突破日线高点时做多，突破日线低点时做空，通过挂单方式在突破价位自动入场。出场条件依赖止损和止盈设置，止损设在区间内测以控制风险，止盈根据ATR或固定点数设定。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的方式，缺乏动态调整机制。资金管理方面仅依赖基本的风控参数，未包含复杂的资金管理算法，存在连续亏损后风险放大的可能。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on daily price range breakout trading, assuming that when price breaks above the previous daily high or below the daily low, the trend is likely to continue. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks the daily high and a sell when price breaks the daily low, using pending orders at breakout levels for automatic execution. Exit conditions rely on stop loss and take profit settings, with stop loss placed inside the range to control risk and take profit calculated based on ATR or fixed pip values. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes or percentage-based methods but lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms. Money management relies on basic risk parameters without complex algorithms, posing potential risk amplification after consecutive losses.

parameters.name: RangePeriod
parameters.description: 日线范围计算周期天数
parameters.description_en: Daily range calculation period in days

parameters.name: OrderDistance
parameters.description: 挂单距离突破价的偏移点数
parameters.description_en: Pending order offset from breakout price in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简单，基于价格突破易于理解和验证
利用日线级别区间突破，过滤了部分市场噪音
挂单入场方式避免了情绪化交易，执行力强
pros_en: Clear and simple strategy logic based on price breakout, easy to understand and verify
Daily-level range breakout filters out some market noise
Pending order entry avoids emotional trading with strong execution discipline
cons: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在不同行情下表现差异大
缺乏趋势过滤器，在震荡行情中容易频繁触发假突破导致连续亏损
仓位管理过于简单，未包含动态调整或资金管理算法
cons_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit do not account for market volatility changes, leading to inconsistent performance across different market conditions
Lacks trend filter, prone to frequent false breakout triggers in ranging markets causing consecutive losses
Position sizing is overly simplistic without dynamic adjustment or money management algorithms
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整盈亏比
加入趋势过滤器如均线方向或ADX指标，减少震荡行情中的假突破入场
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to automatically adjust risk-reward ratio based on market volatility
Incorporate a trend filter such as moving average direction or ADX indicator to reduce false breakout entries in ranging markets

risk_points: 固定止损可能在高波动行情中不足够覆盖正常波动范围
缺乏新K线检查机制可能导致同一根K线内重复开仓
没有最大持仓或最大亏损限制，极端行情下风险敞口不可控
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss may be insufficient to cover normal price swings in high volatility conditions
Lack of new bar check mechanism may cause repeated position openings within the same bar
No maximum position or maximum loss limit, leaving risk exposure uncontrolled in extreme market conditions
